description: Convert HTML to clean Markdown for reading or feeding to a model: headings, lists, links, images, code blocks, GitHub-style tables and strikethrough. Give the HTML inline ("html") or as a file ("path": local path or base64). Optional "readable" keeps only the main article (Mozilla Readability, falls back to the whole body), "selector" converts only matching elements, "baseUrl" makes relative links absolute, "includeLinks": false drops link URLs and images. Scripts, styles and forms are removed. Inline Markdown is cut at maxChars (default 200k) with a note; give "output" to save the whole thing to a .md file. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

baseUrl.description: URL the HTML came from, to make relative links and images absolute.

html.description: The HTML text. Give this or "path".

includeLinks.description: Keep links and images. False turns links into plain text and drops images.

maxChars.description: Cut the inline Markdown after this many characters, with a note (a file written with "output" is never cut). Default 200000.

output.description: Write the Markdown to this file (or folder ending in "/") and return its path instead of the inline text.

path.description: An .html file instead of "html": local path or base64.

readable.description: Keep only the main content (article text), dropping navigation, ads and footers.

selector.description: CSS selector: convert only the matching elements (e.g. "main", "article .post").

name: ai_html_to_markdown
title: HTML to Markdown
